## Orientation

Territory: wave 1 has two subagents in `/home/andrewyin/se-workflow--run-facts` (branch `phase/run-facts`). You own only `contract/project-design.json` and `tests/test_estimate_contract.py`. The sibling `estimate-skill` owns `skills/plan-phase/SKILL.md` and `tests/test_estimate_skill.py`. Do not edit those, `dashboard/`, `.artifacts/`, or `~/adaptive-artifacts`.

The approach's copy of the contract onto `.artifacts/project-design.json` is the parent's job on the primary checkout `/home/andrewyin/se-workflow`. Do not edit `.artifacts/` in the worktree or the primary checkout. Do not call `adaptive-artifacts`. Do not commit.

A shell function named `adaptive-artifacts` points at `~/.artifacts/se-workflow`, which is not this repo. Tests use `tests/conftest.py` and `tests/helpers.py` against temp stores. Run pytest from the worktree. You may run tests while the sibling task runs; stay inside your two files.

Write `tests/test_estimate_contract.py` first and see it fail, then edit the contract. `create_generic_record` fills every payload field, so generic work-items gain `size` `XS` and `estimate_minutes` `test-estimate_minutes`. If `tests/test_contract_self_consistency.py` or `tests/test_plan_wave_rules.py` fail only because those keys appeared, update that assertion in this task. Do not special-case the helper.

## Requirements

R1: A work-item may carry `size` of `XS`, `S`, `M`, `L`, or `XL`. Absent means the size is unset. The meanings are: `XS` a trivial or local change, `S` a small change, `M` a moderate change, `L` a substantial or multi-file change, `XL` a large or high-risk change.
R2: A work-item may carry `estimate_minutes`, a non-negative integer, meaning the working time of that task's executor. Absent means unset. Zero is a recorded estimate. The field name is `estimate_minutes`.

## Invariants

Absent `estimate_minutes` are not zero. `size` and `estimate_minutes` are not derived from each other. The sitting line remains `one sitting` or `more than one`. Minutes refer to `payload.executor`, and a missing executor means subagent. Assignee is not the rollup key. There is no `minutes` field and no `hours` field.

## Assumptions

`estimate_minutes` is a whole number. A wave's tasks share one executor. The derived `wave` is the grouping. Old work-items have neither field until a later edit, and totals skip them.

## Decisions

task-agent-estimate: Each work-item stores size XS, S, M, L, or XL and estimate_minutes for its own executor. Inline minutes in a wave add. A subagent wave elapsed estimate is its longest task. Phase elapsed time adds those wave figures in wave order. The phase stores neither field.
glance-run-facts: Defer dashboard display until size and estimate_minutes are stored. A later phase shows the sitting line and executor as title suffixes.
